description: Defines ASN.1 NGAP protocol structures, including message types, procedures, and related containers for 3GPP TS ASN1 NGAP v18.8.0, with classes for NGAP PDUs and procedures.

classes.name: ngap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the NGAP Protocol Data Unit with methods to set, get, pack, unpack, and serialize NGAP messages.

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an NGAP Initiating Message with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful NGAP message outcome with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents an unsuccessful NGAP message outcome with procedure code, criticality, and message content.

classes.name: ngap_elem_procs_o
classes.description: Defines NGAP elementary procedures, including initiation, success, and failure message types, with associated procedure codes and containers.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the message type for NGAP PDU or procedure message.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the message into a bit buffer.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Deserializes the message from a bit buffer.

methods.name: to_json
methods.description: Serializes the message to JSON format.

methods.name: load_info_obj
methods.description: Loads message info based on procedure code.
